## Screenshots and diagnostics

Attach a screenshot of the error if possible.

Right after the problem happens, before restarting Orbit, use the report option in your app:

- **TV app:** App settings → Diagnostics & about → Save diagnostic report. Select a drive and attach the saved report. Crossbar, Cinema and Panorama call the main menu Settings.
- **Browser:** App settings → Diagnostics & about → View diagnostics, or Settings → Diagnostics & about in the other layouts. Select Copy diagnostic report and paste it below, or save the report to a drive.

Recent diagnostic events reset when Orbit restarts. If Orbit can’t
open, say so and give the error or notification you can see.
